envelope: group-conditional (Mondrian): the guarantee is conditional on 'language', and exchangeability within group is ASSUMED here and not proved by this run

worst-of-4 claim with the simultaneous correction: alpha 0.050 -> 0.012500 and delta 0.050 -> 0.012500 per slice, 3 claims per slice, so the family risk is 4 x 3 x 0.012500 = 0.1500 and the joint level is 0.8500

beta is NOT divided and the divided budget is NOT spent: every slice's bound is tested against the uncorrected 0.050, which is the number that gates this run, and bounding each slice at 0.050 already bounds the worst at 0.050; 0.012500 is published as the counterfactual a divided budget would have cost, and no bound in this artefact is compared with it

an UNCORRECTED worst-of-4 at delta=0.050 would claim 1 - 4 x 3 x 0.050 = 0.4000, which is a probability, but only until the census is large enough to break it: the line above is the claim this run actually makes, and it is paid for by the division this one undoes

the pooled (marginal) certificate over these same records is published beside the slices and is NOT a substitute for them: NOT_CERTIFIABLE: reason=empty_feasible_set at alpha=0.050, beta=0.050; n_cal=5948 n_eval=5948; at coverage 0.950 the 1010 automated cases include 107 carrying a wrong automated request; the exact case-level upper bound 0.123 exceeds the budget 0.050
